description: STAR (Sentient Transformative Autonomous Reality) is the WEB5 layer of the OASIS -- an ODK (OASIS Development Kit) / HDK (Holochain Development Kit) that generates production-ready Rust hApp zome code, C# HoloNET ORM models, REST API controllers, and full-stack scaffolding from a high-level STAR definition. Write your data model once; STAR generates the entire stack. Combines HoloNET, OASIS, and Holochain to make hApp development radically faster. Part of the OASIS Omniverse at https://oasisomniverse.one
releaseNotes:
- Initial NuGet release as part of the OASIS Omniverse Reboot and Rebrand under oasisomniverse.one.
- Upgraded to .NET 10 — latest runtime with improved performance and language features.
- Full integration with OASIS API Core v2.0.0, WEB6-WEB10 layers, ONET, FAHRN, HyperDrive v2, and OASIS MCP Server.
- Security-hardened: CORS, JWT, and NuGet vulnerability remediation.
- Many misc improvements.
- Multiple bug fixes.
title: OASIS STAR ODK
